title: Kontext Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Kontext adapter. Nothing is required: a missing value must never reject the whole imp.

sellerId.description: The publisher's seller_id in sayhola.ai/sellers.json (its dashboard publisher id). Used as the sid of our supply-chain node.

placementId.description: Our placement id, normally the Stored Imp id. Sent as imp.tagid.
